sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the accused-applicant has submitted that civil proceeding were pending in which a cheque of Rs. 1.50 (Uploaded on 12/11/2025 at 04:42:41 PM) [2025:RJ-JP:44541] (2 of 3)
[CRLMB-11694/2024] crore was given in execution proceedings.
It is further submitted that the primary allegation of the complainant is that cheque which was dishonored was of a non-existent bank "OBC".

Learned counsel for the accused-applicant has submitted that vide an order dated 05.02.2025, interim protection from arrest was granted to the applicant, subject to joining the investigation at the concerned police station.
In compliance of the aforesaid, the applicant has duly joined the investigation.
It is further submitted that the matter is purely civil in nature.
It is further submitted that co- accused is one of the witness.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor as well as learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the instant bail application.

4. Having heard the contentions put-forth by the counsel for the parties, considering that the accused-applicant has already joined the investigation, as directed vide an interim order dated 05.02.2025; that the matter is purely civil in nature and looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and material on record but without commenting on merits/demerits of the case, this court deems it appropriate to make the order dated 05.02.2025 absolute and allow the instant anticipatory bail application.
5. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

The S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer, Police Station Sadar, Jaipur District Jaipur City (West) in F.I.R.
